title: How to obtain an investor visa in Dubai?
description: Learn step by step the process to obtain the Dubai Investor Visa. Find out the requirements for this document and how to get it quickly.
authorHtml: • Nakul Sachdeva

breadcrumb.name: How to obtain an investor visa in Dubai?

featuredImage.alt: How to obtain an investor visa in Dubai?

contentHtml:
• The investor owns property worth at least AED 750k
    • The bank pays 50% of the total value upfront for the mortgaged property
    • The investor provides the bank with a no-objection letter written in Arabic
    • The property can be divided among spouses, but the investor must provide a marriage certificate
    • The property must be residential
    • The investor can apply through a jointly owned property if their share has a value of AED 750k or more.

    4. Carrying out your medical examination

    5. Obtain your Emirates ID

    6. Obtain adequate health insurance coverage

    7. Get your passport stamped with the investor visa

      • Become a partner in a new or existing company with a minimum share value of AED 10 million

      • The amount invested must be a loan
      • Financial stability of up to AED 10 million.

      • The property must be residential

    5. Obtain your Emirates ID

    6. Obtain adequate health insurance coverage

    7. Get your passport stamped with the investor visa

      • Financial stability of up to AED 10 million.

• The investor owns property worth at least AED 750k

    4. Carrying out your medical examination

    5. Obtain your Emirates ID

    6. Obtain adequate health insurance coverage

    7. Get your passport stamped with the investor visa

      • Become a partner in a new or existing company with a minimum share value of AED 10 million

      • The amount invested must be a loan
      • Financial stability of up to AED 10 million.

      • The property must be residential
